deferredComponents.name: VacationRentalPotential
deferredComponents.reason: Retired 2026-07-30. The mount passed a hardcoded `projection={null}` since D77, so the section had never rendered. A pro-forma needs a nightly-rate + occupancy source AND the City of Bend STR permit status for the address; neither exists in this repo or the database (lib/vacation-rental-potential.ts is an unsourced heuristic behind an unconfigured STR_PROVIDER_URL, and listing_search_mv.str_permit_yn is a self-reported MLS field, not the City permit register). Same treatment as ClimateRiskBlock: a section that cannot be sourced does not ship.

deferredComponents.name: TransparentCMASummary
deferredComponents.reason: Retired 2026-07-30. The mount passed a hardcoded `cma={null}` since D77, so the section had never rendered. Wiring it to public.cmas is blocked on client confidentiality, not on engineering: every candidate row is a client document. Of 220 rows, 3 are client-ready CMAs carrying a subject_listing_key; 2 are competitor-brokerage Closed listings with no built html_content, and the third is Ryan Realty's own Active listing where the CMA range sits below the seller's list price. Publishing that on a buyer-facing page discloses a seller client's valuation and negotiating floor (ORS 696.805 loyalty and confidentiality), and the underlying sold comps are VOW-restricted under the ODS rules. The 'show our work' surface is the CMA document itself and the seller LP, not the public listing page.
